_help: Each source is one place Bon Temps checks for events. type: tribe (WordPress 'The Events Calendar' sites), jsonld (pages with built-in event data), ical (calendar feeds), saffire (Saffire venue sites), downtown (Downtown Lafayette event pages), page (AI reads the page; runs on GitHub only), ticketmaster (needs TICKETMASTER_API_KEY). Set enabled to false to turn one off. venue is used when an event doesn't say where it is. cats adds categories to every event from that source.
